headline: New maximum fuel prices for Wednesday are known. See how much you will pay at most per liter
summary: The Energy Minister set Wednesday's maximum prices at 6.86 zloty for Pb95, 7.74 for Pb98 and 7.80 for diesel per litre. Gasoline caps are higher than Tuesday's and diesel caps lower.
why: Poland regulates maximum retail fuel prices through the Energy Ministry, which affects fuel retailers and consumer inflation.
